title: T1589.002 — Gather Victim Identity Information - Email Addresses
subtitle: Interactive walkthrough of Gather Victim Identity Information - Email Addresses with the technique-specific attack path and defender evidence.
aria: Animated simulation: Email address harvesting and verification campaign. It shows each step of the technique and what defenders can see. A written version of every step is in the story below the canvas. Use the step buttons under the canvas, or focus the canvas and press the left and right arrow keys.

nodes.label: Attacker
nodes.tip: Collects names, guesses the naming format, and verifies which addresses exist. Everything they do here happens outside your network.

nodes.label: Public web
nodes.tip: Your website and published files. Team pages, mailto links, and document metadata reveal names, roles, and addresses.

nodes.label: Professional net
nodes.tip: Professional networks that show org charts, new hires, and job titles. A second source that confirms names and roles.

nodes.label: Mail server
nodes.tip: The server named by your MX record. It answers recipient tests, so it is the one place verification becomes visible.

nodes.label: Verify service
nodes.tip: Paid email-verification services that probe mail servers at scale and sell the results. They hide the probing step.

nodes.label: Employees
nodes.tip: People whose addresses were verified. Finance and HR rank first, because they move money and handle payroll.

nodes.label: SOC
nodes.tip: Your detection and response team. They count rejections, correlate scraping bursts, and brief the frontline teams.

steps.caption: The attacker picks Aurelia Pay, a mid-size payments company, and starts reading everything public about its staff.
steps.defender: Nothing to see yet. Target selection happens entirely outside your visibility.
